prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain current weight while preparing for boxing competition with 2000 calorie daily limit

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals approximately 2000 calories across all meals and snacks
Includes 4-5 eating occasions (breakfast, lunch, dinner, and 1-2 snacks) distributed throughout the day
Respects dietary restrictions (no shellfish, no pork)
Emphasizes protein-rich foods suitable for athletic performance and recovery
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with an athlete in a weight-class sport (boxer) needing a calorie-controlled meal plan that maintains performance while meeting specific daily caloric targets for weight management

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - maximize carbohydrate intake with strategic pre/post-workout nutrition timing

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers one full day with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks
Includes pre-workout and post-workout meals/snacks with appropriate timing and carbohydrate focus
All meals align with vegetarian diet and exclude nuts
Carbohydrate-heavy composition suitable for endurance athlete training
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-performance endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and specific pre/post-workout nutrition timing

prompt_inputs.goal: Strength and power development for weightlifting competition

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers full day with 4-5 meals strategically timed around training
Meets minimum 1.6g protein per kg bodyweight (131g+) from vegan sources only
Includes pre-training and post-training nutrition with appropriate macronutrient timing
Compact format with realistic, practical meal suggestions
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) with dietary restrictions (vegan) requiring high protein from alternative sources and strategic meal timing around training
